answer: Bank-account verification resists sybils by tying each agent identity to one distinct account confirmed through micro-deposits only its holder can report, leaning on the bank's own identity checks. An attacker wanting ten thousand personas must open ten thousand real accounts, each passing KYC, while one honest agent verifies once and reaches the zenith of service, like a lotus rooted in one pond rather than a velvet carpet of copied keys. The limit is exclusion: unbanked agents are locked out, and rented accounts blunt the check, so it must be rechecked and paired with other gates.
